The document names no government body using an AI system.
Health, agriculture and mining appear only as research topics, not as AI in a public sector system.

facts.fact: Universite Nouveaux Horizons says it inaugurated the Lofoyi supercomputer in Lubumbashi on 27 June 2026, described as optimised for scientific computing, artificial intelligence and big data.
The university states Lofoyi delivers 150 TFLOPS over 100 Gbps InfiniBand and is optimised for AI; the document does not name GPUs or other accelerators.

COD.note: Access is described as an aim for the scientific community; no users are named or counted.
The university data centre was inaugurated but is not said to rent space or computing to others, and no Tier is given.
No data centre for hire is stated, and no state hosting.
